title: Scientific Notation Converter
description: Convert between standard form, scientific notation and engineering notation in both directions.
howto: Enter the number (and exponent for reverse conversions).
Press Convert to see the result and the decimal-point shift.

faqs.a: Scientific keeps 1 ≤ a < 10; engineering forces the exponent to a multiple of 3, matching SI prefixes like kilo and mega.
Move the decimal point 4 places left: 0.00025.

faqs.q: Why is the exponent negative for small numbers?
faqs.a: Each leftward decimal shift divides by 10, so a number like 0.003 needs 10^-3 to scale back up.
